scope: Original static check/build records for 5f and 2a51, independent B10 static reviews, and historical context only. No product checks or desktop actions were run during archival.
statusMeaning: Per-file pass refers only to its recorded static command or static-review scope. Partial denotes preparatory or contextual material. No milestone or desktop completion is asserted.
excluded: All desktop directories and every run02 artifact, including completed-looking intermediate snapshots
All fixtures, live application data, process logs, and UI captures
All app bundles, executable binaries, target, node_modules, .git, and full repositories
Current source-tree state checks, rebuilds, tests, GUI actions, commits, and milestone status changes

knownLimitations.STATIC_ARCHIVE_ONLY: This package is not a desktop, CI, D06, or Q98 acceptance result.
knownLimitations.OLD_CHECKS_ARE_NOT_NEW_VERSION_RERUN: The old 5f check records remain attributed to 5f; they are not represented as rerun on 2a51.
knownLimitations.OLD_BUILD_ENVIRONMENT_NOT_FULLY_RECORDED: Old build command JSON did not record exact environment values. The preserved build.py inherits HOME/PATH, prepends /opt/homebrew/bin, and sets CARGO_NET_OFFLINE; missing values were not reconstructed.
knownLimitations.RESOLVE_IS_PREPARATION: Offline cargo metadata was dependency preparation, not an extra product test. Its before/after lists differ only at Cargo.lock; the change is preserved.
knownLimitations.CHECK_BASE_PRECEDES_FIXED_COMMIT: resolve/rust base-sha is 5f because the B10 changes had not yet been committed. Their actual recorded source lists and fixed-source-check.json are preserved without rewriting base-sha. The post-resolution and Rust/build lists match.
knownLimitations.RUST_CHECKS_DO_NOT_REPLACE_DESKTOP: The recorded 271 passed / 0 failed / 1 ignored Rust result is an implementation check, not native AppKit or close/exit acceptance.
knownLimitations.ANALYSIS_IS_NOT_RAW_EXECUTION: This is preserved analysis or a post-hoc report, not a raw command/CUA response transcript.
knownLimitations.RECORDED_ASSOCIATION_NOT_NEW_REPO_CHECK: fixed-source-check.json is an existing record. Archival does not rerun its source-to-commit comparison.
knownLimitations.REVIEWS_ARE_STATIC_ONLY: The independent reports found no definite static finding within their stated range; they do not establish runtime or milestone completion.
knownLimitations.HISTORICAL_ANALYSIS_NOT_CURRENT_DESKTOP_: archive-audit.md is preserved as written. Its C05/run02 and other desktop statements describe its historical observation boundary and must not be read as current desktop status; subsequent run02 work is excluded and no current verdict is generated.
knownLimitations.OLD_C02_FAILURE_REMAINS_FAILURE: The old 5f C02 captured a successful Git result, then exited before explicit result release. It remains a failure; this does not mean Git was killed or data was lost. failure.json is post-hoc context and the underlying desktop originals are outside this static package.

comparisonBasis: Only preserved evidence files were compared. No current repository, binary, fixture, or live log was hashed by this script.
